name: After root removal, what are the next steps to ensure my sewer line remains clear?

mainEntity.name: After root removal, what are the next steps to ensure my sewer line remains clear?

acceptedAnswer.text: After successful root removal, the next crucial steps often involve identifying the cause of entry and considering long-term solutions. This might include regular follow-up camera inspections, typically annually or bi-annually, to monitor for new root growth. If the pipe is damaged or has persistent entry points, permanent repairs like trenchless pipe lining or excavation and replacement of the affected section may be necessary. CG Plumbing Solutions will discuss the condition of your pipes post-removal and recommend a customized preventative maintenance plan. This process clarity helps manage expectations about what may happen after the service.
acceptedAnswer.description: After root removal, monitor with regular camera inspections and consider long-term solutions like pipe repair or replacement if entry points persist.
